thought.text: Let me query actual content and verify core functional areas.

reasoning_content:
Let me check the front page and actual content presence. Let me also verify the site's title/menu. Let me look at what actual expected URLs exist. Let me fetch page objects list. But maybe more important: check the default content installed (nodes, media).

Let me use drush php:eval to query entities.

action.command: cd /workspace && su ddevuser -c "ddev drush php:eval \"echo 'nodes: '.\Drupal::entityQuery('node')->accessCheck(FALSE)->count()->execute().PHP_EOL; echo 'media: '.\Drupal::entityQuery('media')->accessCheck(FALSE)->count()->execute().PHP_EOL; echo 'users: '.\Drupal::entityQuery('user')->accessCheck(FALSE)->count()->execute().PHP_EOL; echo 'terms: '.\Drupal::entityQuery('taxonomy_term')->accessCheck(FALSE)->count()->execute().PHP_EOL;\"" 2>&1 | tail -6
